notes: Written by game design. Mechanic and attack semantics are defined in docs/game/GAME_DESIGN.md section 13. Optional fields the engine may use: look.template (bossArt template), mechanic.resetOn, mechanic.buffDrain.

bosses.name: Inflato the Slow Leak
bosses.title: Shrinker of Dollars
bosses.lesson: Inflation quietly shrinks idle cash, so you beat it by learning to put money to work, not by swinging harder.
bosses.intro: Your dollar bought a burrito last year. Now it buys most of a burrito. Next year? A tortilla. I'm patient.
taunts: Every second you stall, I grow back. That's how this works.
Cash under the mattress? Delicious.
Three percent a year doesn't sound like much. That's my favorite part.
Same price, smaller bag. You won't even notice.
bosses.defeat: Fine. Park your money somewhere that out-earns me. I'll be back next year, at about three percent.

look.description: A round pink balloon-blob with a tied knot on top and a leaky patch hissing tiny gold dollar signs. Smug half-lidded eyes and a gold price tag dangling from the knot.

mechanic.text: Inflato regains 1 HP every second outside Focus Time. Chip shots can't keep up: charge with right answers and hit hard.

attacks.name: Price Surge
attacks.text: An expanding ring of price tags. Slip through a gap or dash straight through it.

attacks.name: Rate-Hike Hail
attacks.text: Shadows mark where coins will land. Step out of the circles.

attacks.name: Lifestyle Creep
attacks.text: A slow blob follows you and grows the longer it lives. Shoot it early or lead it into a wall.

attacks.name: Shrinkflation
attacks.text: The arena walls close in for 3 seconds. Same arena, less room: get to the middle.

attacks.name: Inflation Balloon
attacks.text: Swelling price balloons drift at you, then pop into a ring. Pop them early from range or get clear.

bosses.name: Vex the Volatility Vulture
bosses.title: Circler of Drawdowns
bosses.lesson: Volatility is the price of growth: people who keep investing through drawdowns usually beat people who try to time the exit.
bosses.intro: Markets drop. People panic. People sell at the bottom. I eat well. Let's see if you flinch.
taunts: Down 20 percent! Sell everything! ...No? Hm.
Timing the market is easy. You just have to be right twice.
The scariest drop always feels like the last one.
Look at all that red. Doesn't it make you want to leave?
bosses.defeat: You stayed in. Nobody stays in. ...Well, the ones who did are mostly doing fine.

look.description: A scrawny purple vulture with a red zig-zag stock-chart crest and ragged spread wings. Beady yellow eyes, hunched like it's waiting for you to panic.

mechanic.text: Every 20 seconds Vex flies out of reach for 5 seconds: the drawdown. You can't hit her, but you can keep answering. Charge through the dip and come out swinging.

attacks.name: Red Candle Rain
attacks.text: Red candles drop on marked spots. Keep moving between the shadows.

attacks.name: Panic Dive
attacks.text: She tucks her wings, then dives in a line. Dash sideways, not backwards.

attacks.name: Feather Fan
attacks.text: A fan of 5 feathers. Up close the gaps are wider; stand in one.

attacks.name: Panic Dive
attacks.text: Swoops straight through where you stand, shedding feathers. Sidestep the line.

bosses.name: Count Ponzi
bosses.title: The Pyramid King
bosses.lesson: A Ponzi scheme pays early investors with new investors' money, so it collapses as soon as the new money stops.
bosses.intro: Guaranteed 20 percent a month, zero risk! Bring a friend, earn a bonus! Why would a man in a cape lie to you?
taunts: Returns are guaranteed! The guarantee is also guaranteed.
Don't ask where the money comes from. It's... strategy.
Act now! This offer ends in ten minutes!
My early investors love me. The later ones, less so.
bosses.defeat: No new recruits... no new money... the whole pyramid is... wobbling...

look.description: A short count in a purple cape and a tall gold pyramid-shaped crown. Slick mustache, enormous grin, a fistful of glittering fake certificates.

mechanic.text: Every 10 seconds Ponzi recruits a new investor (up to 3). Each one feeds him 1 HP per second. Recruits quit after 3 chip shots or any charged shot. Stop the new money and the scheme falls apart.

attacks.name: Guaranteed Returns
attacks.text: 3 slow gold certificates chase you and pop on walls. Lead them into one.

attacks.name: Pyramid Scheme
attacks.text: He leaps and a triangle shadow marks the landing. Get out of the triangle.

attacks.name: Recruitment Drive
attacks.text: A ring of flyers spreads out. Dash through a gap.

attacks.name: Limited-Time Offer
attacks.text: A wall of ACT NOW signs sweeps across with one gap. Walk to the gap; don't rush into the wall.

attacks.name: Pyramid Scheme
attacks.text: One payout splits in two, then four, then eight. Get out of the fan before it spreads.

bosses.name: Fudge the Bookcooker
bosses.title: Chef of Adjusted Earnings
bosses.lesson: Profit can be dressed up with accounting choices, but cash flow is much harder to fake, so check where the money really went.
bosses.intro: Revenue up 400 percent! Adjusted revenue. Community-adjusted revenue. Please don't read the footnotes.
taunts: That loss was one-time. Like the last six.
Profit is whatever I say it is.
Cash flow statement? Never heard of her.
Which one of me is real? Read the numbers.
bosses.defeat: You read the cash flow statement. Nobody reads the cash flow statement!

look.description: A plump chef in a white jacket and tall toque with a red bow tie, stirring a pot of boiling ledger pages. Papers poke out of every pocket and his eyes dart sideways.

mechanic.text: Every 20 seconds Fudge cooks up 2 decoy copies of himself. Decoys take no damage. Only the real Fudge casts a gold coin-colored shadow: cash is a fact. Hit the real one and the decoys vanish.

attacks.name: Adjusted Earnings
attacks.text: A fan of 5 inflated numbers. Step into a gap.

attacks.name: Off-Balance-Sheet Surprise
attacks.text: He winds up his ladle and flings one fast ledger at you. Sidestep on the wind-up.

attacks.name: Boiling Books
attacks.text: The pot boils over in a ring of hot pages. Dash through a gap.

attacks.name: Cooked Books
attacks.text: Numbers freeze mid-air, get rearranged, then all fly at you. Move after they stop.

bosses.name: Mr. Market
bosses.title: Your Moody Neighbor
bosses.lesson: Prices swing with crowd emotion, so a patient investor buys when fear makes good companies cheap and ignores the euphoria.
bosses.intro: Hello, neighbor! Today I'll sell you my shares for double what they're worth. Or half. Depends how I feel.
taunts: Everything is wonderful! Buy! Buy right now!
Everything is terrible. Take these shares off my hands. Please.
You don't have to trade with me. But you want to, don't you?
New price tomorrow. And the day after. Forever.
bosses.defeat: You only dealt with me when my price was right. That's annoyingly smart.

look.description: A lanky man in a blue suit whose head is a two-faced theater mask, one half grinning gold and one half frowning. His tie is a jagged green-and-red price line.

mechanic.text: Every 15 seconds Mr. Market flips mood. Euphoric: fast and reckless, and he takes 20% more damage. Despair: slow, heavy attacks, then a 3-second slump where he stands still. Buy the panic.

attacks.name: Hype Rush
attacks.text: He sprints at you grinning. Dash sideways when the gold face flashes.

attacks.name: Panic Sell-Off
attacks.text: A shockwave ring from his frowning side. Dash through it as it reaches you.

attacks.name: FOMO Lure
attacks.text: A shiny coin drifts toward you like a free pickup. It's a trap: shoot it or walk away. The Scam Radar Ring flashes it red.

attacks.name: Mood Swing
attacks.text: 6 masks in a wide fan. Close the distance and stand in a gap.

attacks.name: Mood Swing Wave
attacks.text: A weaving stream of quotes. Don't follow the wiggle, step out of its lane.

bosses.name: Tilt, the Revenge Titan
bosses.title: Bad Trade, Worse Mood
bosses.lesson: Losses trigger biases like revenge trading and FOMO, so a written plan and fixed position sizes beat acting on emotion.
bosses.intro: You lost one? Win it back! Double the size! Right now! Who needs a plan?
taunts: Just one more trade to get it back.
Everyone else is getting rich. Hurry!
Stop-loss? Stops are for quitters.
You're due for a win. Statistically. Probably.
bosses.defeat: You took a breath and followed your plan? That's so boring. And so effective.

look.description: A hulking red stone titan with cracked, glowing orange veins and steam blasting from its ears. One fist clutches a smashed phone showing a red number.

mechanic.text: Below 50% HP, Tilt loses his cool: 30% faster, but sloppier. Stay calm, keep answering, and let him make the mistakes.

attacks.name: Revenge Trade
attacks.text: He stamps twice, then charges in a line. Dash sideways after the second stamp.

attacks.name: Doubling Down
attacks.text: A wide fan of 6 rocks. Stand in a gap or get behind him.

attacks.name: FOMO Fireballs
attacks.text: 2 fireballs chase you. Lead them into a wall or shoot them down.

attacks.name: Blowup
attacks.text: Both fists up, then a huge ground slam. Leave the red circle before it fills.

attacks.name: Tilt Tantrum
attacks.text: A chain of slams marching toward you. Move sideways, not backwards.

bosses.name: The Theta Reaper
bosses.title: Collector of Time Value
bosses.lesson: Options lose time value every day, faster as expiration nears, so time works against the buyer and for the seller.
bosses.intro: Every option I touch melts a little each day. Yours too. Tick. Tock. That premium is mine.
taunts: Extrinsic value? I'll take that.
Thirty days left. Twenty. Ten. Feel it speeding up?
Out of the money at expiry. My favorite word: worthless.
Enjoy your volatility. It won't last past earnings.
bosses.defeat: You used your time better than I could take it. Expiration comes for us all...

look.description: A hooded reaper in a tattered black robe with a glowing green hourglass where its face should be. Its scythe blade is bent into a Greek theta.

mechanic.text: The hourglass never stops. Every 15 seconds the Reaper hits 10% harder (up to double), and your shields and timed buffs drain twice as fast. Nothing resets it: finish before time does.

attacks.name: Decay Scythe
attacks.text: He raises the scythe, then sweeps a wide arc in front. Get behind him or out of reach.

attacks.name: IV Crush
attacks.text: After a green glow (his earnings), a ring that also wipes your shields. Dash through it.

attacks.name: Pin Risk
attacks.text: A circle marks your spot and a pin drops on it. Step off the mark.

attacks.name: Expiry Rain
attacks.text: Hourglasses fall on marked spots. Weave between the shadows.

attacks.name: Time Decay
attacks.text: The safe zone shrinks toward the middle. Get inside the purple circle before it closes.

bosses.name: Magmus Vega
bosses.title: Heart of Volatility Volcano
bosses.lesson: Higher volatility makes options pricier and moves bigger in both directions, so defined-risk trades survive eruptions that naked bets don't.
bosses.intro: Calm is boring. Let's make things volatile. Hope you bought defined risk, little options trader.
taunts: Implied volatility 120 percent. Feeling expensive yet?
Sold a naked call? Bold. Unlimited, even.
After the eruption comes the crush.
Straddle me if you dare.
bosses.defeat: You capped your risk on both sides. I can't erupt through a spread...

look.description: A craggy volcano golem with a crater for a head that bubbles over with lava. Glowing orange cracks across its chest curve like a volatility smile.

mechanic.text: Every 12 seconds Magmus switches. Eruption: fast and wild, and he takes 20% more damage. Dormant: slow, heavy lava, then a 3-second IV crush where he barely moves. Strike during the crush.

attacks.name: Lava Ring
attacks.text: A ring of lava bursts out. Dash through a gap as it reaches you.

attacks.name: Vol Spike
attacks.text: Molten rocks rain on marked spots. Keep moving.

attacks.name: Naked Call
attacks.text: Unlimited downside: a huge straight-line charge after a long rumble. Dash out of the lane.

attacks.name: Smile Volley
attacks.text: 7 embers in a curved fan. The middle gap is the widest.

attacks.name: Volatility Eruption
attacks.text: Lava pools that linger for six seconds. Don't fight standing in one.

bosses.name: The Margin Caller
bosses.title: He Always Calls Back
bosses.lesson: Futures settle gains and losses every day, and if your account drops below maintenance margin you must add money or be liquidated.
bosses.intro: Your account is marked to market. Daily. By me. Hope you kept a buffer, because I'm about to call.
taunts: Ring ring. It's your maintenance margin.
Ten times leverage! Ten times the feelings!
Small move, big dollars. Mostly big losses.
Can't post margin? I'll close you out myself.
bosses.defeat: You sized small and kept a buffer. I have nobody left to call...

look.description: A tall figure in a pinstriped coat with an old red rotary phone for a head, its cord coiled like a whip. Red numbers scroll across his chest like a ticker.

mechanic.text: Daily settlement: every 15 seconds he marks you to market. If your HP is under 25%, he makes a Margin Call: a question opens at once. Right: you post margin and heal 10 HP. Wrong: lose a pip and take 10 damage.

attacks.name: Leverage Slam
attacks.text: A 10x hit with a long, loud wind-up and a huge red circle. Always dodge this one.

attacks.name: Gap Open
attacks.text: The phone rings, he vanishes and lunges from the edge. Dash the moment you hear the ring.

attacks.name: Liquidation Lock
attacks.text: Red-tape walls close into a box around you. Dash out before it seals.

attacks.name: Mark-to-Market
attacks.text: 7 red numbers in a fan. Stand in a gap or circle around him.

attacks.name: Margin Call
attacks.text: A red line locks onto you, then fires a beam the length of the arena. Step off the line.

bosses.name: The Black Swan
bosses.title: The Event Nobody Priced
bosses.lesson: Extreme events happen more often than neat models expect, so hedges and position sizes should assume the worst day will eventually come.
bosses.intro: Every model said I was impossible. Every model was wrong. Let's see how you're sized for the unthinkable.
taunts: A once-in-a-century move. Third one this decade.
Your stop gapped. Sorry about that.
Fat tails. Very fat. Extremely fat.
Hedged? Good. Sized small? Better.
bosses.defeat: You prepared for me without knowing when I'd come. That's the only way anyone beats me.

look.description: A sleek black swan with purple-tipped wings and glowing pink eyes. Its long neck curves like a bell curve with a fat tail trailing behind.

mechanic.text: Fat tails: below 30% HP the Swan gets 30% faster and its attacks come sooner. Keep some HP and a buffer in reserve for the ending.

attacks.name: Tail Event
attacks.text: Rare and huge: the screen darkens and a giant shadow marks the hit. You get 1.5 seconds. This is what damage caps are for.

attacks.name: Gap Down
attacks.text: A wall of black feathers drops across the arena with one gap. Find it fast.

attacks.name: Feather Storm
attacks.text: Feathers fall on marked spots. Weave through.

attacks.name: Contagion
attacks.text: 3 dark orbs chase you. Lead them into walls or shoot them before they converge.

attacks.name: Black Swan Event
attacks.text: The lights go out and only your corner is visible while shots come in. Keep moving.
